name: tooltip
gotchas: matTooltip on a disabled `<button>` never shows, because disabled native elements don't receive the mouse/focus events the tooltip listens for — wrap the button or drive `matTooltipDisabled` from your own state if you need a tooltip on a disabled control.

Touch devices show the tooltip on long-press by default (`touchGestures: 'auto'`), which can conflict with a custom long-press interaction on the same element — set `touchGestures: 'off'` if you're handling touch yourself.
`matTooltipPosition` is a hint, not a guarantee — MatTooltip repositions itself when the requested position would overflow the viewport, so don't rely on it for pixel-exact layout.
